lines.speaker: DESC
lines.label: Dominion Energy SC planner
lines.text: Hi, I am calling about your Plant McIntosh expansion near Rincon, Georgia. Our one hundred fifteen kilovolt tie project touches right there.

lines.speaker: GPC
lines.label: Georgia Power planner
lines.text: Hey. Yeah, we saw those projects are right next to each other. How does the timing look on your end?

lines.speaker: DESC
lines.label: Dominion Energy SC planner
lines.text: We are looking at March through December of twenty twenty-eight. What about you?

lines.speaker: GPC
lines.label: Georgia Power planner
lines.text: Our build window starts June twenty-eight, so we have about a seven month overlap there.

lines.speaker: DESC
lines.label: Dominion Energy SC planner
lines.text: That is what we figured. We could probably share outage coordination, right-of-way, access roads, permits, and a staging yard.

lines.speaker: GPC
lines.label: Georgia Power planner
lines.text: Definitely. And maybe share material deliveries, crews, and equipment too.

lines.speaker: DESC
lines.label: Dominion Energy SC planner
lines.text: Our rough planning estimate is about two hundred fifty thousand dollars in savings, ranging from one hundred thousand to over four hundred thousand.

lines.speaker: GPC
lines.label: Georgia Power planner
lines.text: That is a solid chunk of change. Let us set up a follow-up meeting to share our route and outage details.

lines.speaker: DESC
lines.label: Dominion Energy SC planner
lines.text: Sounds good. I will send over a calendar invite today. Thanks for chatting.
